messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Camera Operation
parts:
this message

Error: stationCol = "Station" is not a column name in CTtable

means that there is no column called "Station" in the CTtable. CTtable must be a data frame. In your code, you state: CTtable      = "camtraps"
Note the quotation marks. They make "camtraps" a character string. What you want is CTtable      = camtraps   (assuming you have a data.frame called camtraps in your workspace).
You can compare the output of these two to see for yourself:
 class("camtraps")
 class(camtraps)

The next relese will check this and return a meaningful error message.

About the second problem: I'm not sure what this is. Do you get this error when you run the following:

example(cameraOperation)      # this will run the code in the examples section of the R help file.
